# Omalaunch keyboard shortcuts

<!-- GENERATED by `omalaunch --dump-shortcuts`. Do not hand-edit. -->

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `j` | Move selection down |
| `Down` | Move selection down |
| `k` | Move selection up |
| `Up` | Move selection up |
| `Home` | Jump to first |
| `End` | Jump to last |
| `Page_Down` | Move down a page |
| `Page_Up` | Move up a page |
| `slash` | Focus search |
| `Return` | Launch selected AppImage |
| `p` | Play selected AppImage |
| `a` | Add AppImage |
| `u` | Update selected AppImage |
| `x` | Remove selected AppImage |
| `Delete` | Remove selected AppImage |
| `f` | Toggle favorite |
| `h` | Hide selected AppImage |
| `s` | Open settings |
| `question` | Show shortcuts |
| `Escape` | Clear search / back |
